qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Unmatched scale with >€13B annual advertising budget, €1.3B+ R&D engine, and global omni-channel distribution across Luxe, Consumer, Dermatological Beauty, and Professional. Delivers consistent 74%+ gross margins and 19-22% GAAP ROIC (40%+ Operating ROIC). Pricing power demonstrated through continuous positive price/mix compounding above inflation across cycles. Primary risks include travel-retail volatility and Chinese domestic brand competition.
